question_text:
Implement an infrastructure automation script for **Challenge #35: Observability, Telemetry & Incident Mitigation**.

### Problem Specification:
- Write a robust Python or Bash systems script (e.g., container health checker, log parser, deployment validator, or Prometheus metric exporter).
- Incorporate error trapping (`set -euo pipefail` or `try/except`), timeout limits, and clean exit codes.
- Ensure idempotent execution.
answer_explanation: Evaluates infrastructure parsing, status filtering, and safe script execution under Observability, Telemetry & Incident Mitigation.

criteria.name: Functional Correctness
criteria.description: Passes all visible and hidden unit test cases without errors.

criteria.name: Code Structure & Cleanliness
criteria.description: Idiomatic naming, handling edge boundaries and null guards.
